name: hedged_two_asset_volatility_target_overlay
question_template: An investment desk holds a USD {CORE} million core equity position whose annualized return volatility is {SIGMA_E} percent. It overlays an index futures position with return volatility {SIGMA_H} percent; the correlation between core and futures returns is {RHO}. The overlay ratio h is the futures notional as a fraction of core value, positive for long and negative for short, so the overlay return equals h times the futures return. Working in percentage-point-squared units (a 20 percent volatility is a variance of 400), the hedged portfolio variance is sigma_E^2 + h^2 sigma_H^2 + 2 h rho sigma_E sigma_H. The desk wants portfolio volatility of exactly {TARGET} percent. If that target is at or above the minimum attainable volatility over all real h, choose h among the ratios that hit the target: take the one with the smaller absolute value, and the negative one if the two are tied. If the target is below the minimum attainable volatility, set h to the minimum-variance overlay ratio instead. Report the signed futures notional, h times core value, in USD million.

slots.description: Core equity variance in percentage-point-squared units.
Minimum attainable portfolio variance over all overlay ratios.
Whether the volatility target can be reached with some overlay ratio.
Signed overlay ratio chosen under the stated selection rule.

program:
def solve():
    V = P["CORE"]
    sE = P["SIGMA_E"]
    sH = P["SIGMA_H"]
    rho = P["RHO"]
    T = P["TARGET"]
    core_var = sE * sE
    min_var = core_var * (1 - rho * rho)
    h_min = -rho * sE / sH
    target_var = T * T
    if target_var >= min_var:
        flag = "attainable"
        s = sqrt(target_var - min_var)
        h1 = (-rho * sE - s) / sH
        h2 = (-rho * sE + s) / sH
        a1 = abs(h1)
        a2 = abs(h2)
        if a1 < a2:
            h = h1
        elif a2 < a1:
            h = h2
        else:
            h = h1 if h1 <= h2 else h2
    else:
        flag = "unattainable"
        h = h_min
    notional = h * V
    return {
        "final": notional,
        "core_variance_pp2": core_var,
        "min_variance_pp2": min_var,
        "target_attainable": flag,
        "selected_hedge_ratio": h
    }
